subject: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurelius.com>
Cc: Tom Willis <tom.willis@aurelius.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T22:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap from our demo and a compact proposed POC playbook attached so your team can review: key goals, success criteria, technical prerequisites, timeline, and owners. TL;DR — we recommend a 4-week scoped trial focused on two use cases you highlighted (policy ingestion + agent-assisted triage).

Highlights in the attachment (POC-playbook-aurelius-v1.pdf):
- Objective: Validate model accuracy on policy extraction (F1 >= 0.78) and end-to-end triage flow latency under 600ms median for sample traffic.
- Success criteria: quantifiable acceptance tests, owner sign-offs, and a pass/fail gating checklist.
- Data needs: representative sample CSV (column schema attached as data-sample-specs.csv).
- Security: short ask list in security-quick-asks.docx — we can provide SOC2 evidence & network architecture diagram on request.
- Timeline proposal: Week 0 prep (data ingest + access), Week 1 baseline metrics, Weeks 2-3 iterative tuning, Week 4 acceptance run & retrospective.

Proposed owner assignments (internal / external):
- Aurelius: Elena (product), Tom (infrastructure) — primary sign-off stakeholders.
- Redwood: Ben Carter (SE lead) — environment & test harness; Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — success criteria & adoption plan; me (Naomi) — program lead and contract/comms.

Next steps I suggest this week:
1) You confirm the data sample delivery target (we recommended EOD Wed, Apr 24).
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff next Monday (Apr 23) to confirm access and runbooks.
3) You send any required redlines for the trial statement of work — we can fast-track to legal.

If that looks good I’ll lock the kickoff and ping Ben to provision test endpoints and a sandbox tenant.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0188

Attachments: POC-playbook-aurelius-v1.pdf (11 pages), data-sample-specs.csv, security-quick-asks.docx
From: Elena Park <elena.park@aurelius.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Willis <tom.willis@aurelius.com>
Date: 2028-04-21T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)

Naomi —

Appreciate the summary and the playbook. This is the level of detail we need. Quick answers/requests from our side:
1) Data sample: we can deliver a sanitized dump of 5k policy documents in the format you specified by EOD Wed (Apr 24). We will include a small holdback set for acceptance testing.
2) Security: Tom will follow up with a deeper set of questions; the quick asks doc helps. We should exchange our standard DPA and an initial list of compliance docs.
3) Timeline: Apr 23 kickoff is fine for us — please propose a time.

Two clarifying points: for the acceptance run, is the F1 target measured on the holdback set you mentioned? Also, can you confirm whether the sandbox will be hosted in our AWS account or Redwood-managed test tenant? We prefer our account for governance but open to options.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Product — Aurelius Systems
Elena.Park@aurelius.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurelius.com>
Cc: Tom Willis <tom.willis@aurelius.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-21T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)

Elena — thanks, that works. Short answers inline:

> is the F1 target measured on the holdback set you mentioned?
Yes — acceptance F1 will be computed strictly on the holdback set to avoid tuning leakage. We’ll share the evaluation harness so you can reproduce the metrics.

> sandbox hosting preference (your AWS vs Redwood-managed)
We can support both modes. For speed of setup we suggest Redwood-managed sandbox for the first run (isolated tenant we provision in our environment). If you prefer ingress from your VPC we can run in your AWS account; that requires an IP allowlist and IAM role setup which would add 2 business days. Recommend: Redwood-managed for Week 1 baseline, then migrate to your account if desired for Week 2 tuning.

I’ll propose two kickoff slots: Apr 23 10:00am PT or Apr 23 3:30pm PT — which do you prefer? Also looping Ben and Marissa — Ben will confirm test harness and Marissa will follow up on stakeholder RACI and acceptance sign-off flow.

Naomi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurelius.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Willis <tom.willis@aurelius.com>
Date: 2028-04-21T18:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)

Elena — quick technical checklist from my side so the kickoff is productive:
- Data: please include column headers exactly as in data-sample-specs.csv; we need text_id, source_type, raw_text, published_date, policy_category. If you have embedded PDFs we’ll need OCR output as raw_text.
- Auth: for Redwood-managed sandbox I’ll provision an OAuth client + API key; for your AWS we need an IAM role ARN and a small CloudFormation snippet (I can send this).
- Baseline tests (Week 1): 
  * Ingestion throughput: ingest 5k docs in under 30 minutes (we’ll report throughput).
  * Metric harness: F1, precision@k, latency percentiles (p50/p95).
  * Integration smoke: sample agent flow with 50 concurrent sessions at modest load.
- Acceptance runner: we’ll provide a reproducible script (python) that runs the holdback set and uploads a results CSV. We ask your product owner to run it and sign off with date-stamped results.

I can take the 10:00am PT kickoff on Apr 23. Naomi — I’ll ping infra to prep the sandbox and share credentials to Elena’s email once ready.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Elena Park <elena.park@aurelius.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Willis <tom.willis@aurelius.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed POC playbook, owners & acceptance criteria (Aurelius Systems)

Thanks everyone — 10:00am PT on Apr 23 is confirmed for Aurelius. We will deliver the sanitized 5k sample by EOD Wed Apr 24 and include the holdback set. Tom will follow up with the compliance list and a note on which AWS account we prefer to start (likely our account, but we accept the 2-day tradeoff).

Elena
